title: SABA Garba Night at HBS
description: Experience the magic of Navratri at HBS - dance, feast, celebrate!
long_description:
Experience the magic of Navratri at HBS - dance, feast, celebrate!

About this Event

It’s time to spin, twirl, and celebrate! 💃🕺 South Asian Business Association (SABA) is hosting Garba at HBS - a dazzling evening of dancing, food, and festivities inspired by the vibrant folk tradition of Navratri.

🌸 Highlights:
High-energy Garba and Raas dancing - no past experience needed, we'll guide beginners!South Asian Dinner :)
📍 Location: Batten Hall, Harvard Business School
🗓 Date & Time: Thursday, October 22nd, 7-10pm
🌹 Dress in Festive Traditionals / dance-friendly clothes. We'll provide dandiyas!
🎟 Open to all Harvard students & partners!

✨ Spots are limited due to space constraints - grab your tickets asap!

Garba is a traditional folk dance from Gujarat, India, performed in circles during Navratri - nine nights of music, movement, and devotion. Dancers clap, twirl, and use dandiya sticks in a lively celebration that brings everyone together.
